SD: Sum of values (Σx)

Sum of the x-values. With FreqOn each class is weighted by its frequency.

Σx is the running total of all observations. Every DT adds that value (times its frequency, if you used one).

formula
∑x=x1​+x2​+⋯+xn​
FreqOn: ∑x=∑xi​fi​
keys
SHIFT→1→2→EXE

Example

Data: 2, 4, 6, 8 (four numbers)
Sum = 2 + 4 + 6 + 8 = 20
Σx = 20
steps

On the calculator

  1. MODE→1→EXE (4. If you were already in SD, SHIFT 9 (Stat) to clear the old list)
  2. 2→DT
  3. 4→DT
  4. 6→DT
  5. 8→DT
  6. then AC
  7. SHIFT→1→2→EXE→Σx = 20

Example with frequencies (FreqOn)

75 once, 80 twice, 85 four times
Σx = 75×1 + 80×2 + 85×4
Σx = 75 + 160 + 340 = 575
steps

On the calculator

  1. Confirm FreqOn in SETUP, then MODE 4
  2. 75→DT
  3. 80→DT→DT
  4. 85 ; 4 DT
  5. then AC
  6. SHIFT→1→2→EXE→Σx = 575
note

x̄ = Σx / n. If Σx looks wrong, a leftover Stat buffer or a frequency typed with FreqOff (Syntax ERROR / skipped) is the usual cause.
